newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk MPs vote against impeaching former minister.
newsitem.headline: Turk MPs vote against impeaching former minister.

text.p: Turkish MPs on Tuesday voted against impeaching the former energy minister, Sinasi Altiner, a move that boded well for Deputy Prime Minister Tansu Ciller who faced a similar ballot later in the day.
"The proposal...has been rejected," Deputy Speaker Kamer Genc said after announcing the vote result, in which deputies voted 395 to 106 against sending Altiner to the Supreme Court.
Altiner, a minister in an earlier coalition headed by Ciller, was alleged to have been involved in corruption at the TEDAS electricity company.
MPs later began debating whether to impeach Ciller on charges of not preventing graft at the state-run company during her three-year spell as prime minister, from 1993.
A vote will also be held later in the session on whether to send Ciller to the Supreme Court on the more serious charge of illegally interfering with the sale of state-owned carmaker TOFAS.
The Islamist-led government would be in deep trouble if coalition partner Ciller lost the votes but analysts predict victory for her.
